title: Axiom Immersive Visor S
description: The Axiom Immersive Visor S is a Signature-original immersive visor in the vr headsets family. It tracks the working profile of Meta Quest 2 — standalone VR headset: the headset that brought standalone VR to the mainstream. Introduced in 2020, it serves mainstream users.
